'''SpecForce Command''' was the organization charged with the leadership of the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was headed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]], the primary founder of the SpecForce Division.
